name: bell2_s9_onset_gains
description: BELL2: onset band gains of bell_tip (stage 9); everything except NL is on. Each strike restarts the gain envelope for every ringing mode, earlier ring included (PORT_MAP f.3); the gains start at contact sample 13 (f.4). BOW2 (all gains 1.0) and EDGE (edge_frac >= 0.9) have no onset gains.
